journey.title: Correct a typo in the driver note with the left arrow
journey.goal: While the calendar is on the page, ArrowLeft in another text field still moves the caret so the user can fix their text

Move the caret back one character

functionalJourney.title: Pick a delivery day with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking a day in the calendar fills the delivery day

guards.title: Move the delivery day with arrow keys
guards.goal: Arrow keys in the delivery day field still move the selected day

plan.root_cause: Pikaday's global keydown listener prevents default actions for arrow keys whenever the datepicker is visible, even when focus is not on its associated input field, causing ArrowLeft to be blocked in other inputs.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify pikaday.js's _onKeyChange handler to only process arrow keys (and related keys) when the datepicker is visible AND the event target is the pikaday field, preserving default behavior elsewhere.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowLeft will now move the caret in the notes input, allowing users to insert a space and correct text as intended.
functional_risks: ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right navigation within the datepicker will no longer work when focus is not on the delivery-date field (e.g., after clicking the calendar).
If the datepicker is opened via programmatic means without focusing its field, arrow keys will be inert.
verification_requirements: Verify that typing 'Gate4', pressing ArrowLeft, then Space results in notes value 'Gate 4'.
Verify that when the delivery-date field is focused, ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down still change the selected date in the datepicker.
Verify that Enter and Esc still close the datepicker and blur the field when it is focused.
Verify that no JavaScript errors are thrown in the console during these interactions.
